description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/weather/alerts (base $0.02; USDC on Base only); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?lat=38.9&lon=-77 or ?area=CA (one point or one US state). Active alerts for one point (lat, lon) or one US state (area), passed through from api.weather.gov: event, severity, urgency, headline, expires, areaDesc, instruction, description, status, messageType and id. Not an official warning service; not affiliated with or endorsed by NOAA/NWS. For life-safety decisions use weather.gov and local authorities. Up to 60 s old. Charged per answer, including when no alerts are active; bad input is refused before payment, not charged. USDC on Base only.
